precedence_rules: 2. ODP_AUTH_OIDC_ENABLED -- legacy boolean alias, 'true' -> oidc, 'false' -> local (mode.py:93, 106-107).

3. A configured, non-placeholder issuer in the caller's oidc_issuer_vars -> 'oidc' (mode.py:108-109). The default is DEPLOYMENT_OIDC_ISSUER_VARS = ('ODP_WEB_OIDC_ISSUER',) (mode.py:51). modules/opsboard/auth/config.py:302 passes API_OIDC_ISSUER_VARS = ('ODP_AUTH_OIDC_ISSUER', 'ODP_WEB_OIDC_ISSUER') (mode.py:56-59).
evidence_items.error_semantics: resolve_auth_mode returns a (mode, error) tuple and never raises. An invalid ODP_AUTH_OIDC_ENABLED returns ('local', reason) at mode.py:95-96; an invalid ODP_AUTH_MODE returns ('local', reason) at mode.py:97-98; a mode/flag conflict returns (mode, reason) at mode.py:101-104. oidc_provider_enabled is the fail-closed consumer: it is True only when mode == 'oidc' AND error is None (mode.py:126-127), so a self-contradicting environment disables OIDC rather than guessing.
inputs_that_are_not_resolver_inputs: ODP_OIDC_ISSUER -- does not appear anywhere in the tree (git grep exit 1).
ODP_GCP_OIDC_ISSUER -- does not appear anywhere in the tree (git grep exit 1).
evidence_items.explicit_vs_unset_notes: Explicit ODP_AUTH_MODE=local (or ODP_AUTH_OIDC_ENABLED=false) forces local even when an issuer variable is populated. Unset mode flags with a configured ODP_WEB_OIDC_ISSUER resolve to 'oidc'. Live D15 compliance therefore cannot be inferred from unset mode flags alone -- see control live_deployment_auth_mode_readback.

evidence_items.description: Web runtime resolver and OIDC enablement gate
precedence_rules: 3. ODP_WEB_OIDC_ISSUER, and only that variable, when configured and non-placeholder -> 'oidc' (runtime.ts:114-116).
evidence_items.error_semantics: Unlike the Python resolver, the TypeScript resolver throws. An invalid ODP_AUTH_OIDC_ENABLED throws at runtime.ts:89-93, an invalid ODP_AUTH_MODE at runtime.ts:96-98, and a mode/flag conflict at runtime.ts:101-105. Callers convert the throw into a fail-closed HTTP 503 rather than a default mode.
evidence_items.gate_behavior: isOidcEnabled returns false whenever resolveAuthMode is 'local' (runtime.ts:134-137). In 'oidc' mode it requires ODP_WEB_OIDC_ISSUER, ODP_WEB_OIDC_CLIENT_ID and ODP_WEB_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET together, otherwise it throws (runtime.ts:139-143).

evidence_items.description: Login route omits the OIDC button and refuses provider=oidc when authMode is local
evidence_items.observation: Line 342 computes const showOidc = authMode === 'oidc' and passes it to the page renderer (line 347). Lines 68-75 build oidcButtonHtml only when options.showOidc is true, so in local mode the '使用 OIDC 登入' anchor is not present in the HTML at all. A direct GET /login?provider=oidc in local mode is refused at lines 302-312 with a fixed HTTP 503 and error code WEB_AUTH_PROVIDER_DISABLED; there is no 404 path and no provider call. An unresolvable mode is refused earlier at lines 268-281, also 503.
evidence_items.corrected_from_prior_revision: The prior revision described this as returning '404 / 503'. The rejection status is a fixed 503.

evidence_items.description: OIDC callback route rejects before any provider interaction in local mode
evidence_items.observation: GET resolves the mode at lines 49-62; a throw becomes HTTP 503 WEB_AUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED. When authMode === 'local', lines 64-74 return HTTP 503 { error: { code: 'WEB_AUTH_PROVIDER_DISABLED', summary: 'OIDC authentication provider is disabled.' } } with cache-control: no-store, before any query parameter is read and before any cookie is opened. Lines 76-88 additionally reject an incomplete OIDC configuration with 503 WEB_AUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED. The authorization code exchange (exchangeAuthorizationCode) at line 104 is unreachable in local mode.
evidence_items.corrected_from_prior_revision: The prior revision gave the guard block as 47-87 and the local rejection as 64-73, and cited a non-existent apps/web/src/app/auth/callback/route.test.ts.

evidence_items.description: Cloud Run preflight requires OIDC inputs only when auth_mode is oidc
evidence_items.observation: Line 44 imports resolve_auth_mode from the shared resolver. Line 1426 calls it and captures both the mode and the error; line 1429 records ok=(auth_mode_error is None), so an invalid configuration fails the preflight instead of silently defaulting. Line 1434 gates OIDC_REQUIRED_PUBLIC_CONFIG and OIDC_REQUIRED_SECRET_REFERENCES behind auth_mode == 'oidc'. A password-first deployment passes the preflight with no OIDC secret present.

evidence_items.description: Terraform checks enforce OIDC variables only for prod with OIDC enabled
evidence_items.observation: The three OIDC-related assertions use condition = !(local.is_prod && local.oidc_enabled) || (...). Every other assertion in the file uses the unconditional !local.is_prod || (...) form, so the OIDC guards are the only ones gated on oidc_enabled. A default password-first deployment satisfies them vacuously.

evidence_items.description: The password path does not read any Google/OIDC client secret
evidence_items.observation: localAuth.ts imports only ./crypto, ./identityStore and ./runtime (lines 1-3), and contains no occurrence of OIDC, GOOGLE or CLIENT_SECRET (grep matched 0 lines). Password verification is delegated to the identity store's verifyPassword (localAuth.ts:228-231), implemented as Argon2id with rehash-on-verify in apps/web/src/lib/auth/identityStore.ts:36-37 (interface) and 165-193 (Argon2id verify with rehash-on-verify). The comparison of fixture-style candidates uses constantTimeEqual (localAuth.ts:170).
evidence_items.corrected_from_prior_revision: The prior revision said localAuth.ts itself performs Argon2id verification; it delegates to identityStore.ts.

evidence_items.description: Session, CSRF and throttle controls do not depend on OIDC state
evidence_items.observation: The web session cookie is __Host-oday_web_session (apps/web/src/lib/auth/runtime.ts:3) and is issued with httpOnly, secure, sameSite 'lax' and path '/' (session.ts:395-401). CSRF is an origin/referer check, verifyCsrfOrigin, defined in runtime.ts:157-204 and invoked by apps/web/src/app/login/route.ts:361, apps/web/src/app/auth/password/route.ts:91 and apps/web/src/app/auth/logout/route.ts:27. The login throttle runs before credential verification: login/route.ts:471 obtains the store, :489 calls beginAttempt, and a missing or unreachable store fails closed with 503 (:472-484, :490-501) rather than serving an unthrottled login. Throttle state persists in identity.login_attempts (loginThrottle.ts:445, 503-519). None of these paths reads an auth-mode variable.
evidence_items.corrected_from_prior_revision: The prior revision attributed the CSRF origin check to route.ts and cited a non-existent securityE2E.test.ts.

evidence_items.description: The API auth boundary refuses OIDC tokens unless OIDC is authoritatively on
evidence_items.observation: config.py:23 imports API_OIDC_ISSUER_VARS and oidc_provider_enabled from the shared resolver; config.py:302 calls oidc_provider_enabled(source, oidc_issuer_vars=API_OIDC_ISSUER_VARS). Because oidc_provider_enabled is True only when the mode is 'oidc' and the configuration carries no error, ODP_AUTH_MODE=local plus leftover OIDC inputs disables OIDC at the API boundary as well as in the release path -- the divergence that ODP-WEB-LOCAL-AUTH-API-TRUST-001 closed (mode.py:13-18).
evidence_items.note: The API accepts ODP_AUTH_OIDC_ISSUER in addition to ODP_WEB_OIDC_ISSUER (mode.py:56-59) because the API process never receives the Web variable. This is a per-consumer difference, not a third global issuer variable.
